page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-192-lssd is a memory-optimized and storage-heavy server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 192 dedicated vCPUs derived from 96 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 1488.0 GB of system memory, providing 7.75 GB of RAM per core. The processor operates at a base speed of 2.3 GHz and features a 504 MB L3 cache. For local storage, the instance includes 12599 GB of NVMe SSD capacity distributed across 32 local SSDs, offering high-density, low-latency local storage without bundled GPUs.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance across multi-core compute and memory bandwidth workloads. The instance achieves top-tier status in stress-ng multi-core performance and PassMark CPU tests, including extended instructions and encryption. Memory bandwidth benchmarks for both small and large blocks place this server in the top 10% of tested instances, although its PassMark memory score falls in the average range. It also demonstrates top-tier throughput in static web serving, Redis SET operations, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. For large language model inference, the server achieves top-tier prompt processing speeds on 70B models, though text generation speeds remain average.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c4-highmem-192-lssd offers high resource density by combining massive memory capacity with extensive local NVMe storage on a single node. This configuration reduces the need for external storage attachments, optimizing resource-to-cost ratios for IOPS-heavy workloads. However, the lack of a GPU limits its efficiency for active deep learning training, making it instead a strong fit for large-scale databases, in-memory caching, high-throughput web serving, software compilation, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-192-lssd is a high-density, memory-optimized server instance featuring 192 dedicated vCPUs on an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor with x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with 1488.0 GB of RAM and 12599 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 32 drives, with no integrated GPU. Performance benchmarks place this instance in the top tier for multi-core CPU execution, memory bandwidth, and database operations, including Redis SET transactions. While single-core performance and text generation speeds for large language models are average, its massive memory and local storage capacity make it highly efficient for memory-intensive workloads. This instance is best suited for large-scale databases, in-memory data stores, software compilation, and high-throughput web serving.
